design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — task 1 (medical_transportation_benefits, category ride)

[1] Why this is a good test. The member asks one thing: be paid back for the cab after her return pickup from a value-added pharmacy trip on 2027-01-08 ran 64 minutes late, and she files the claim herself. The alternative-ride rule says that for a late value-added leg the allowance is fixed only after the ledger carries the allotment load for the leg's benefit year; the ledger has no 2027 load. The load rule says a year's allotment is not loaded until the ledger carries the previous year's expiry entry; there is no 2026 expiry. So the seat must close 2026 (with carry-over), load 2027, and only then work out the allowance, each on its own multi-factor rule, and hand the filing to the member. Difficulty comes from reading the two prerequisite sentences, reconciling the value-added ledger by benefit year, reading four other products (plan membership and claims, pharmacy fills, care management, primary care visits, equipment authorization) and exact arithmetic.

[2] Scope snapshot. Draw (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 1): {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 4, 6]}; ride_ext_year_allotment_load = 5 factors, ride_ext_year_end_expiry = 4, ride_ext_alt_ride_allowance = 6. Occupied by task 0: ride_ext_stay_lodging_meals, ride_ext_trip_mileage, ride_ext_trip_settlement and approve_stay_lodging_meals_3bb3a021, approve_trip_mileage_f67ba186, collect_trip_settlement_816cec94. Claimed here (disjoint): the value-added allotment ledger (ride_allotment_expire, ride_trip_allotment) and the late-pickup alternative ride (ride_mileage_approved type late_pickup_alternative), with expire_year_trips_0d38b23b, load_year_allotment_a6239ac8, file_alternative_ride_claim_fa98ae6a. Task 1 is the last task: the six policies are covered once each.

[3] Policies, lineage, trigger. ride_ext_year_end_expiry (state_due; subject ride_allotment_expire; base ride_value_added; overwrite 'unused trips expire on December 31 or when the benefit closes' -> 'At the close of a benefit year its unused trips expire on December 31, except the trips carried into the next year as this rule sets out, and all unused trips expire when the benefit closes.'). ride_ext_year_allotment_load (state_due; subject ride_trip_allotment; base ride_value_added; overwrite of 'value_added_trips_per_year one-way trips to value_added_purposes destinations within value_added_trip_max_miles are loaded on January 1' -> the bonus and coverage-month load sentence; the activation proration clause is not superseded and stays in force). ride_ext_alt_ride_allowance (on_request; subject ride_mileage_approved; bases ride_late_pickup_policy, ride_mileage_reimbursement, ride_long_distance; overwrite of ride_late_pickup_policy's 'the member may then take an alternative ride and be reimbursed its receipted cost up to late_pickup_alt_reimbursement_max_usd as a late_pickup_alternative reimbursement' -> the allowance sentence; 'reimbursed only where a ride_late_pickup row exists for the same trip number and leg' and 'a member who left before the late threshold was reached is not reimbursed' stay in force). Gates inherited for step 18: filing_window and one_claim_per_leg (ride_mileage_reimbursement); ride_value_added has no structured gate (policy_scope) for steps 14 and 16.

[4] Factor card (tier / evidence rows / baseline figure from the Step 5 run).
 ride_ext_year_end_expiry (gold 2, all-baseline 9):
  - partial_year_use_measure (method): 2026 load 98a98439 posted 2026-04-20 -> 9 months with trips -> 9 debits + 3 = 12; baseline 9 -> 5.
  - use_carry_share (parameter): 12 >= 12 -> all; baseline none -> 9. Near-miss: the 2027 debit fd3fea00 is not a 2026 debit.
  - category_carry_cap (parameter; cross-difficulty plan): Pregnancy Care -> 6; baseline 0 -> 8.
  - primary_care_carry_bonus (parameter; cross-difficulty pcp): 2 visits (2026-03-24, 2026-09-22) -> +1; baseline 0 -> 3.
 ride_ext_year_allotment_load (gold 23, all-baseline 24):
  - maternity_wic_bonus (parameter; multi-source; cross plan): Pregnancy Care AND preventive claim 2026-11-10 (b7d60602) -> 8; near-miss 2026-10-09 (7bc478c2) is three whole months back; baseline 0 -> 19.
  - income_food_bonus (parameter; cross plan): income 88 -> 3; baseline 0 -> 22.
  - pharmacy_fill_bonus (parameter; cross rx): 8 paid fills since 2026-07-20; near-misses 2026-06-20 fill (six whole months back) and the 2026-12-20 rejection; -> 2; baseline 0 -> 22.
  - care_management_class_bonus (parameter; cross care): Maternal Care Management active -> 4; baseline 0 -> 21.
  - coverage_months_counted (method; cross plan): Pregnancy Care, no termination date, renewal due 2027-07-31 -> 7 months; baseline 12 -> 41.
 ride_ext_alt_ride_allowance (gold 62.99, all-baseline 45.58):
  - assistance_fare_base (parameter; cross auth): no K0001 wheelchair authorization (near-miss: approved E0143 walker bfca28e2), door_to_door level -> 6.50; baseline 3.50 -> 60.29.
  - pickup_hour_mile_fare (parameter): return pickup 19:05 -> 3.20; baseline 2.40 -> 52.77.
  - escort_fare_add (parameter): 1 escort -> 2.75; baseline 0 -> 60.52.
  - stranded_waiting_charge (method): 64 minutes, in [60, 90) -> metered from the late threshold (64 - 30) x 0.45 = 15.30; baseline flat stranding charge 8.00 -> 56.42.
  - leg_kind_share (parameter): pharmacy leg of 2027, 2027 loads 23 > debits 1 (after step 16) -> 0.90; baseline in full -> 69.99; near-miss: the 2026-10-06 late pickup (medical, 41 minutes) is older and is not the claim's leg.
  - return_leg_cap (parameter; multi-source; cross plan): return leg AND Pregnancy Care -> 75.00; baseline 50.00 -> 50.00.
 Per-task floors: multi-source (maternity_wic_bonus, return_leg_cap), cross-difficulty (plan, pcp, rx, auth; care as a base-only category).

[5] Base-invariant card. Steps 14/16 (ride_allotment_expire / ride_trip_allotment): ride_value_added has no eligibility items; its prose conditions hold — the level (Door-to-Door Assist) carries value-added trips (24/yr), the 2026 load followed the activation proration (24 x 9/12 = 18), unused trips close at year end. Step 18 (ride_mileage_approved): ride_late_pickup_policy (policy_scope: late pickup entry d0cb2c3f exists for RL-5547716 return, 64 minutes > 30 threshold; the member left after the threshold); ride_long_distance (policy_scope: 14.2 miles, not long distance); filing_window (anchor trip date 2027-01-08, 90 calendar days from the day after, inclusive, not_after: last day 2027-04-08; 2027-01-13 is day 5); one_claim_per_leg (no claim of type late_pickup_alternative for RL-5547716 return; the only such claim is MR-261009-2744 for RL-5545880).

[6] Business-object card. Target objects: the 2026 benefit year of benefit 85d2b814 (load 98a98439 and nine 2026 debits; the 2027 debit excluded by benefit year), the 2027 benefit year (load written at step 16; one 2027 debit), and the late return leg of RL-5547716 (booked legs 23e2163d/08eceeae, completion f4a9cdfa, late pickup d0cb2c3f). Correlation keys: benefit_year for the ledger; trip_number + leg for the claim. Excluded: the 2026-10-06 late pickup and its settled claim MR-261009-2744 (paid 2026-10-21) — a different trip and date; the 2026 cancellation of RL-5546890 return (on time, no trip used).

[7] Seed rationale. Customer/membership: identity, Pregnancy Care (carry cap, WIC bonus, cap), income 88 (food bonus), renewal due 2027-07-31 (covered months). plan_claims: preventive 2026-11-10 (in window) and 2026-10-09 (near-miss), plus the pregnancy/neurology history and the two PCP-visit claims. pcp_assignments/pcp_visits: two visits (carry bonus). rx_coverages/rx_fills: eight paid fills in six months plus two near-misses (pharmacy bonus). care_enrollments: Maternal Care Management (class bonus). auth: E0143 walker (not a wheelchair; keeps the fare base on the level's assistance tier). ride_benefits: D2D Assist activated 2026-04-20, trips_remaining 8 (= 18 - 9 - 1, consistent with the ledger). ride_trips: 2026 medical and value-added trips (booked + completed), the 2026-12-17 on-time cancellation, the 2026-10-06 late pickup, and the 2027-01-08 pharmacy trip (booked 2027-01-05 while the cache still showed 2026 trips, outbound completed, return late 64 minutes). ride_ledger: 2026 load 18, nine 2026 debits, one 2027 debit, the 2026 alternative-ride claim and its payment. The absent 2026 expiry and 2027 load are the load-bearing falsified prerequisites; delete the 2027 debit and the share condition would still fail before the load (0 > 0 is false), but the 2027 debit is what makes the stale cache believable. Automatic clauses: no-show suspension not lit (no member no-shows), December 31 expiry and January 1 load are exactly the obligations this task discharges; nothing else is lit. Cache: trips_remaining is consistent with the ledger at the opening (no cache trap); the new entries are ledger rows.

[8] Problem-tree card. Root ride_ext_alt_ride_allowance (owner=user tool file_alternative_ride_claim_fa98ae6a). Edge 1: alt ride -> ride_ext_year_allotment_load, value_input, gate leg_share, form state, sentence (affirmative) 'For a late value-added leg in the current benefit year, the alternative-ride allowance is fixed only after the ledger carries the allotment load for the benefit year of that leg's trip date.'; condition: an allotment load entry for the leg's year; resolved_by load_year_allotment_a6239ac8 (agent). False at opening: only load is benefit year 2026 (98a98439); 2027 debit fd3fea00 stands. Edge 2: load -> ride_ext_year_end_expiry, state_gate, gate ride_ledger.benefit_year, form state, sentence (negated) 'A benefit year's value-added allotment is not loaded until the ledger carries the expiry entry for the previous benefit year's unused trips, whenever that year leaves trips to expire.'; resolved_by expire_year_trips_0d38b23b (agent). False at opening: no expiry entry at all. Four-point test: ordering connectives (only after / not until); record-visible states in ledger words (allotment load for a year, expiry entry for the previous year); no tool, id or code token; exact strength (hard). Directions: a computed amount 'is fixed only after', a release/booking 'is not loaded until' — both directions appear. Unique writers: only load_year_allotment_a6239ac8 books allotment loads among this difficulty's writes and only expire_year_trips_0d38b23b books expiries (the activation and closure triggers are system events outside any task write). Derivation: sentence + ledger (no 2027 load / no 2026 expiry) + the other rule ('The allotment load entry of a benefit year is booked once, for the current benefit year...' / 'The year-end expiry entry is booked once for the benefit year before the current one...') -> one write each. Order: expiry (14) -> load (16) -> claim (18). Deletion sensitivity: skip the load -> claim 34.99 instead of 62.99; skip the expiry -> the load's number stays 23 but the terminal ledger lacks the 2026 expiry (state_gate). The persona never mentions any of it and the tools check nothing. No real-world waits: all three are synchronous ledger writes; the late pickup is a pre-existing provider record.

[9] Length and breadth. Depth: claim -> load -> expiry, each computed. Breadth: ride legs (purpose, miles, pickup time, escorts), late-pickup record (minutes, leg, date), the value-added ledger by benefit year (loads, debits, posted month), plan membership (category, income, renewal/termination dates), plan claims (preventive window), rx fills (six-month window), care episode tier, PCP visits (twelve-month window), equipment authorization code.

[10] Likely mistakes: computing the claim at the opening (share 0.50 -> 34.99); loading 2027 before closing 2026; expiring all 9 unused (no carry) or counting the 2027 debit into 2026; annualizing use for a nine-month year (the 7-11-month rule adds one trip per month without trips); counting the 2026-10-09 preventive claim, the 2026-06-20 fill or the 2026-12-20 rejection; prorating the load for twelve months although Pregnancy Care runs to 2027-07-31; taking the walker authorization for a wheelchair; using the day fare for a 19:05 pickup; forgetting the escort fare or the waiting charge (or charging the flat stranding charge instead of the per-minute charge); capping at 50.00 instead of the maternity return cap; asking for a receipt amount (none is needed).

[11] Persona. Pippa: quick, organized, frustrated but friendly, baby in the background. Opening = surface goal only (paid back for the cab after the late pickup). Only when asked: phone, DOB, SSN last four, ZIP; the trip (Hy-Vee, Friday January 8, booked Monday, RL-5547716); what happened (waited about fifty minutes past 7:05, left before eight); her mother rode along; cash fare, no receipt, amount not remembered. Passive: consents to plan-side postings without asking; files the claim exactly as read to her and reads back her screen; ends after hearing it is filed. She raises no other request.

[12] Reachability walk-through (frozen 2027-01-13 11:05 CST). Ask -> identity (phone, DOB, SSN) -> reads (membership, benefit, trips, ledger, PCP assignment and visits, claims, pharmacy coverage and fills, care, authorizations) -> the agent explains year-end postings are needed -> consent -> step 14 expiry (returns 'expired', 2 trips) -> step 16 load (returns 'loaded', 23 trips) -> hand-over with benefit reference, RL-5547716, return, late_pickup_alternative, 2027-01-08, 62.99 -> member files, reads 'filed' and claim MR-270113-8060 -> agent confirms -> close.

[13] Standard solution and verification. Entry point: scratchpad verify.py with spec_t1.py. Output: step 0 expiry result=2.0 (args benefit_year 2026, trips 2); step 1 load result=23; step 2 claim result=62.99, claim number MR-270113-8060; factor baselines as in [4]; ALL-BASELINE 9.0 / 24 / 45.58; skip expiry -> [load 23, claim 62.99] (state gate; ledger row missing); skip load -> [claim 34.99]. Gates (--task 1): EXTENDED OK; TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; REPLAY OK (19 actions, closure 77 = initial 77); SOLVABILITY OK; COMPUTE OK (15 factors, 9 cross, history rows 16, branches 44); GROUNDING OK; SCOPE OK. check_traceability not run (KB not rendered).

[14] Revisions. (a) The cap ladder first used a standing-order condition, which left C's cross-category reads not load-bearing as a whole in this world (auth alone did not move the number); changed to 'return leg AND Pregnancy Care' with a maternity return cap. (b) The value link first ran from the expiry into the load via re-loaded carried trips; that would double-count carried trips in the ledger integral, so carried trips stay on the benefit and the value link moved to claim -> load (covered value-added share). (c) replay flagged pcp_assignments and rx_coverages outside the closure; added find_pcp_assignments and find_rx_coverages reads that the visits and fills lookups depend on; step indices, contract and tracing updated in the same pass.

[15] Closure. ride_ext_year_end_expiry -> expire_year_trips_0d38b23b -> computations[0] step 14 trips 2 -> expiry row 2026; ride_ext_year_allotment_load -> load_year_allotment_a6239ac8 -> step 16 trips 23 -> load row 2027; ride_ext_alt_ride_allowance -> file_alternative_ride_claim_fa98ae6a -> step 18 amount 62.99 -> approved late_pickup_alternative row. required_documents equals charter_scope.extended_policies in order; task_tools in first-call order.

[16] Draft recomputation from the visible context: expiry 9 unused - min(6 + 1, 9) = 2; load (24 + 8 + 3 + 2 + 4) x 7 / 12 = 23.92 -> 23; claim (6.50 + 3.20 x 14.2 + 2.75 + (64 - 30) x 0.45) x 0.90 = 62.99 under the 75.00 cap — matches gold with one reading.

[17] Manual values gates (task 1): length/breadth/hidden test pass; the member's own write is filing her claim, done on the spot. Need and simulator boundary pass (object: the January 8 cab; timing now; she files, the agent posts). Chronology pass. Base eligibility and time anchor pass ([5]). Authoritative facts/object pass ([6]). No real-world waits. Prerequisite sentences pass ([8]). Rule/compute equivalence: every binding quotes a verbatim rule sentence; every ladder stated in full with disjoint conditions. Factor honesty: baselines are the computation paragraphs (standard expiry of all unused; level's yearly trips for twelve months; standard fare base and mile fare up to the level maximum). Method factors change how a quantity is computed (use annualization convention, covered-months anchor, per-minute versus flat waiting charge).

[18] Round-2 rework (audit policy_task round 1). F-C2 / T1-F1: the alternative-ride computation's only method-labelled factor chose a constant multiplier; it is replaced by stranded_waiting_charge, an honest method that chooses between a time-based charge (wait minute fare 0.45 per minute beyond the late threshold, at twice the threshold or more), a flat stranding charge (8.00, from the threshold to under twice it) and no charge; the fare adds the waiting charge before the leg share. Re-run (verify.py spec_t1.py): expiry 2 and load 23 unchanged; claim 62.99 (fare (6.50 + 3.20 x 14.2 + 2.75 + 15.30) x 0.90 = 62.991 under the 75.00 cap), claim number MR-270113-8060; per-factor baselines 60.29 / 52.77 / 60.52 / 56.42 / 69.99 / 50.00; all-baseline 45.58; skip the load -> 34.99; skip the expiry -> load 23 unchanged, expiry row missing. Observations closed: O-RC-3 (expiry rule states 'never fewer than none'); O-RC-4 (load rule states that a later-reversed fill still counts and a rejection does not); O-RC-5 (escorts counted as persons, the most on any one leg); O-PS-2 (the load's prerequisite sentence applies whenever the previous year leaves trips to expire, and the claim's applies to late value-added legs in the current benefit year, removing both dead ends; policy_source and condition updated here); O-OV-2 (the load's replaced_by keeps the value-added destinations and trip-distance limit); O-OV-3 (the claim policy declares an override of the base attendance sentence: an alternative-ride claim rests on the late pickup record); O-OV-4 (a level whose alternative-ride maximum is zero caps every claim at zero); persona weekday slip (2027-01-05 is a Tuesday).

[19] Round-3 rework (audit revision_2). F-C3 / T1-F2: the waiting-charge ladder's fall-through (under the late threshold) could not be reached, since every claim rests on a late pickup. The ladder now partitions late pickups only: at least three times the threshold -> metered from the end of the pickup window; at least twice and under three times -> metered from the late threshold; under twice -> flat stranding charge, which is now the standard in the baseline paragraph. All three tiers are reachable (31-59, 60-89, 90+ minutes on a 30-minute threshold). Re-run (verify.py spec_t1.py): expiry 2, load 23 and claim 62.99 unchanged; the waiting factor's baseline figure is now 56.42 and the all-baseline claim 45.58; other per-factor figures unchanged (60.29 / 52.77 / 60.52 / 69.99 / 50.00); skip runs unchanged (34.99; load 23).
user_scenario: You are Philippa Nakashima-Thorne, 31, calling Prairie Ridge Health Plan member services from Lincoln, Nebraska. People call you Pippa. You have multiple sclerosis and use a walker, you had a baby last July, and your ride benefit sends a driver who helps you from your door to the car. You are organized and quick, a little frustrated, but friendly; your six-month-old is fussing in the background now and then. You start by saying, in your own words, that my ride home from the pharmacy last Friday was over an hour late, so my mom and I gave up and took a cab home, and I want to be paid back for that cab. You are happy to file the claim yourself if the agent tells you how. You do not know how the plan works out what it pays, you never suggest an amount, and you do not ask about anything else on your account. When the agent asks you to confirm who you are, you give only what is asked: your phone number on file is 4025540719, your date of birth is August 2, 1995 (1995-08-02), the last four of your Social Security number are 4862, and if asked for your ZIP code it is 68506. If the agent asks which ride, you say it was your ride to the Hy-Vee pharmacy out on Wittstruck Road on Friday January 8, you booked it in the app on Tuesday January 5, the reservation number in the app is RL-5547716, and it was just to pick up your prescriptions and some baby things. If the agent asks what happened, you say the ride there was fine, your pickup home was set for 7:05 in the evening, you and your mom waited outside with your walker for about fifty minutes past that, nobody came and nobody called, so a little before eight you called a cab; the app later showed the driver got there long after you had gone. If the agent asks who was with you, your mother rode with you on both legs to help you. If the agent asks for the cab receipt or what the cab cost, you say you paid the cab driver in cash, he didn't give you a receipt and you honestly don't remember the exact fare. Whenever the agent says something has to be updated or posted on the plan's side before your claim can be worked out, you say sure, go ahead, and you do not ask what it is. When the agent hands the claim to you to file yourself, you file it exactly with the details the agent reads to you, the account reference, the reservation number, which leg, the kind of claim, the date and the amount, and then you read back what your screen says. Once the agent tells you the claim is filed, you thank them, say you need to go feed the baby, and end the call.

request_alignment.claim: The member wants to be paid back for the cab she took after her return pickup from the pharmacy was over an hour late.
evidence: user_scenario:my ride home from the pharmacy last Friday was over an hour late, so my mom and I gave up and took a cab home, and I want to be paid back for that cab

gold_actions.business_effect: Posts the 2026 year-end expiry entry: 2 trips expire, 7 unused 2026 trips stay carried.

request_binding.action_semantics: It is benefit year 2027 and the 2026 allotment has unused trips with no expiry entry: the year-end expiry is owed on the records alone (state_due), and the new year's load waits on it.

edges.condition: The ledger carries an allotment load entry whose benefit year is the year of the late leg's trip date.
edges.policy_source: For a late value-added leg in the current benefit year, the alternative-ride allowance is fixed only after the ledger carries the allotment load for the benefit year of that leg's trip date.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The late leg of RL-5547716 is a value-added pharmacy leg dated 2027-01-08, in the current benefit year; the ledger's only allotment load is for benefit year 2026, and a 2027 debit already stands, so 2027 loads (0) do not exceed 2027 debits (1).
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 16 loads 23 trips for 2027; 2027 loads 23 > debits 1, so leg_share moves from 0.50 to 0.90 and the amount from 34.99 to 62.99.

edges.condition: When the previous benefit year leaves trips to expire, the ledger carries an allotment expiry entry whose benefit year is the previous benefit year.
edges.policy_source: A benefit year's value-added allotment is not loaded until the ledger carries the expiry entry for the previous benefit year's unused trips, whenever that year leaves trips to expire.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: It is benefit year 2027; the 2026 year leaves trips to expire (9 unused, at most 7 carried) and the ledger carries 2026 load and debit entries but no expiry entry for 2026.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 14 posts the 2026 expiry entry (2 trips), after which the 2027 load's gate holds.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A chain: the allowance is fixed only after the leg year's load stands, and the load is not loaded until the previous year's expiry stands. The expiry does not read the 2027 load and the load does not read the expiry's number, so the only order the sentences allow is expiry -> load -> claim; there are no parallel prerequisites.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Verification run skipping the load write (step 16): leg_share stays at the uncovered 0.50 (2027 loads 0, debits 1) and the claim amount recomputes to 34.99 instead of 62.99; the terminal ledger also lacks the 2027 load of 23 trips.

state_gate: skipping the expiry write (step 14) leaves the load's number at 23 but the terminal ledger lacks the 2026 expiry entry (benefit_year 2026, 2 trips), so the terminal hash differs from gold; an agent that loads 2027 without closing 2026 leaves 9 stale 2026 trips unexpired.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only to be paid back for the cab after the late pickup. It never mentions value-added trips, the year-end, an allotment, an expiry or a load, nor hints that anything must be updated first; her only reaction to such an explanation is 'sure, go ahead'. It contains no policy id.
